summary: Quashing of FIR based on complaint against IRS officer and spouse; standard: suspicion vs truthfulness at FIR stage; quashing improper for pretrial assessment of evidence; investigation to proceed without judicial intervention; closure report option if allegations unsubstantiated; HC overstepped in requiring case diary/figures tabulation; no imminent arrest threat despite investigation notice.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.13(1)(b), s.13(2)
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment quashing FIR set aside; investigation permitted to continue.
